## Description

Tier-2 suite failure. Fix so the README full suite passes at phase head.

## Approach

Failures: test_skill_close_request_references_check_run_id_for_runner_methods; test_close_batch_does_not_emit_check_run_create_for_runner_methods
Fix tests and/or code on phase/tiered-verification; gitignore `.tier2/` if still missing.
